answer: Duplicate submissions collapse to a single reward, and slashed bonds make forged sybils cost more than honest participation earns, keeping the network's reputation slot layer scarce and verifiable. Agents stake a bond locked in a time-release vault; each epoch they must solve a unique spatial puzzle seeded from live tundra and canyon terrain data, so one solver cannot mass-produce identities without independently sensing the same real-world coordinates. In practice, Agent0105 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
